samples.xml_description:
<module id="LFSR">
    <description>A Linear Feedback Shift Register (LFSR) designed for generating pseudo-random sequences. This 4-bit LFSR uses a specific feedback mechanism to produce a sequence of bits that appears random.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="clk">Clock signal to synchronize the shifting operation.</input>
        <input id="rst">Active high reset signal to initialize the register.</input>
        <output id="out" width_description="[3:0]">4-bit output representing the current state of the LFSR.</output>
    </ports>
    <implementation>Initialize the LFSR with all zeros when rst is high. On each rising edge of the clock, compute the feedback by XOR-ing the most significant bit (out[3]) and the second most significant bit (out[2]), then invert it. Shift the contents of the register to the left and insert the computed feedback at the LSB.</implementation>
</module>
